title: Implement About section variants (about-left, about-right)
description: Implement two About section variants. about-left has the image on the left and text on the right. about-right reverses the layout. Both optionally display stat badges (e.g. '20+ years experience').
acceptanceCriteria: Both accept `{ content: AboutContent, business: BusinessInfo }` props
Both render headline, body text, optional image, optional stats array
Layout reverses correctly between left/right variants
Stats are displayed as highlighted badge chips if present
Verify in browser with Playwright screenshot

steps.details: Two-column grid: image column on left, content column on right. Content: h2 headline, p body text, stat chips (if content.stats). On mobile: stack vertically. Image: rounded corners, object-cover.

Same as AboutLeft but image column on right (use CSS `order-2` or `flex-row-reverse`). Code should share a base structure — consider a single component with an `imagePosition` prop, or simply duplicate with reversed grid order.
Take Playwright screenshot. Verify image appears on correct side for each variant. Check stats chips are visible if provided.
